prompt.adult: How long was Jonah in the belly of the great fish?
prompt.child: How many days and nights was Jonah inside the great fish?

verses.text: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

explanation.adult: Jonah 1:17 tells how long Jonah stayed in the great fish. Read the length of time at the end of the verse and match it.
explanation.child: The verse tells how long Jonah was inside the great fish. Find that length of time and choose it.

teaching.extended_explanation: One, seven, and forty are famous Bible numbers, but they are not this one. Jonah 1:17 gives the length of time at the end of the verse. The LORD prepared that fish. Choose the length the verse names.
teaching.takeaway: Jonah was in the great fish three days and three nights.
